text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with number y.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
Plate(x) ::: x is a license plate.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
FromNumber(y) ::: y is a number.
Premises:
∀x (FromIstanbul(x) → BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: All plates from Istanbul begin with 34.
∀x (¬BeginsWith(x, 34) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates not beginning with 34 are not from Istanbul.
FromIstanbul(Joe) ::: Joe's plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(Tom, 35) ::: Tom's plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.
Conclusion:
BeginsWith(Joe, 34) ::: Joe's plate begins with 34.
